instruction: Set up a local folder called "Reports" and create a message filter to automatically transfer inbox emails with "monthly" in the subject to the Reports folder

metadata.explanation: Variation changes folder name to 'Reports' and filter keyword to 'monthly' (subject contains). Uses same evaluator structure as original with check_thunderbird_filter metric. Verified that filter format matches expected structure with enabled=yes, Move to folder action, and subject contains condition.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete coverage: Instruction has two requirements - (1) create local folder 'Reports' and (2) create filter to move emails with 'monthly' to Reports folder
Evaluator only verifies filter configuration (requirement 2) but does NOT verify folder creation (requirement 1)
Filter verification logic is semantically correct: checks enabled status, action type, target folder path, and subject condition
Getter (get_vm_file) and metric (check_thunderbird_filter) are appropriate and will work correctly at runtime
Postconfig correctly closes Message Filters window to ensure filter file is saved before extraction
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add verification for the Reports folder existence - could check Thunderbird's folder structure file or use a getter to list Local Folders
Consider adding a second evaluation step that verifies 'Reports' folder exists in Local Folders before checking filter rules
Alternative: Update instruction to focus only on filter creation, removing folder creation requirement if folder verification is not feasible

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_filter first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
